name: Clock probe: a 5 s cast counts down by game time and completes on time
contract: Pyroblast rank 1 (11366) has CastingTimeIndex 6 = 5000 ms in the installed SpellCastTimes.dbc; the fresh
level-80 mage has no haste, so spell_cast_time_ms reads 5000 (asserted). Spell::update lowers the cast timer by
each player update's diff, which is the world step, so cast_remaining_ms falls by the game time that passes:
4700..5000 just after the cast, 2200..2530 after a 2500 ms wait, 150..530 after 2000 ms more; the cast then
completes within 1 s and Pyroblast damages the target. The bands allow the step ticks between assertions and
one diff of offset between the cast and the first timer update, so they hold with a 25 ms world step. A cast
timer that ignores fast-forwarded game time stays near 5000; one that runs ahead finishes before the checks.

steps.label: SETUP: the cast takes the DBC 5000 ms
SETUP: the cast started with its full 5000 ms
Wait into the middle of the cast
Wait until the cast nearly ends
DISCRIMINATING: about 500 ms remain near the end
The completed cast damaged the target
